summary: Source macOS Orchestra native workflow recovery adds an adapter-computed lossless JSON input/config/context binding within existing TaskIR v1 identity. All eleven bounded native operators reject numeric alias drift before probe or redispatch, unchanged source Agent/BEAM restarts remain reusable, and same-task-name live thermal inputs retain distinct identities. This is bounded contract/recovery evidence, not independently recomputed Agent integrity or lossless generic TaskIR numeric identity; the latter remains an explicit open qualification scope.

required_text: TaskIR v1 rounds floats to fixed-15
computed binding is idempotent and overrides supplied values without granting authority
an old receipt without exact invocation binding cannot be silently upgraded
native invocation binding preserves numeric payloads and overrides caller claims
The Agent still verifies the existing v1 TaskIR digest
Default adoption and installed workflow recovery rollout remain open.
Full lossless numeric identity across arbitrary TaskIR authors remains open

qualification_requirements.acceptance: Adopt a versioned Rust/Elixir cross-authoring numeric identity contract with independent Agent recomputation; retain tiny, adjacent, signed-zero and config/input drift fixtures plus actual transport and unchanged-identity recovery. Explicit typed v2 authoring, source capability routing and bounded HTTP/Agent/SQLite native workflow continuation are verified, with solves, branches and original receipts retained across Orchestra restart. Default adoption, actual PostgreSQL, executable package-host and installed mixed-peer acceptance remain open. Caller-supplied adapter bindings, opt-in-only evidence and historical fixed-15 qualification cannot satisfy this scope.
